additional_info.subject: RE: ID0484927-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP/PO 170001103] APN Modification Request CRM:03097000516
additional_info.body:
Good evening Mr. Nicolas,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0484927.
Ticket was opened for an issue to change the apn for router XF4 from SCB on charger
MP/PO 170001103.
I checked the charger remotely, and the issue was lying in some incorrect configuration of the charger and the routers:
I checked the logs, and the charger was not able to login the routers.
I checked the configuration files, and the charger was missing the file containing the router password. For this reason, it was not able to login the routers.
I added the file, and noticed that still the communication between routers and charger was not established.
I entered within the webUIs of the routers and the IP of the charger was blocked in both routers. By removing this blocked IP, the routers are now accessible for the charger, hence form SCB:
You will be able now to change the apn for router XF4.
Please provide me confirmation if the issue is solved from your side as well and you are able to change the apn of the router.
​​​​​​​Looking forward to hearing feedback form you soon.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0484927-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP/PO 170001103] APN Modification Request CRM:03097000516
additional_info.body:
Good afternoon Mr. Nicolas,
Thank you very much for your prompt feedback.
This morning I connected to the charger and further analyzed the problem with R&D. We found as origin of this incorrect behavior an another incorrect configuration of the passwords in both routers.
As a consequence, the charger was sending that error message that you saw, stating an issue on the root password of the router. We corrected that, and set the apn that you provided.
Since midday the issue has been cleared, the apn correctly configured, and the charger is online on OCPP without any further failed login error messages.
Please let us know if further support is required, otherwise we will proceed to close the ticket.
Looking forward to hearing form you soon!
With kind regards,
